parts.name: Translation Blade
parts.Basic_description: This is the translation blade of the utility knife, made of stainless steel. It is a small, sharp, and replaceable part located at the front of the knife.
parts.Functional_description: The blade performs the cutting function. It can be extended or retracted for safety and precision cutting tasks.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly along the body of the knife, sliding in and out through a guided slot for adjustable length.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the utility knife, made of durable ABS plastic. It forms the main handle and housing for the blade mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: The base body provides grip, stability, and houses the internal sliding mechanism for the blade. It ensures user control and safety during operation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the structural support for the moving blade and slider components.
